240221206.text: This design manuscript states that I once considered changing the base ingredient of Fonta to "tea leaves."

240221207.text: ...And then I'd release a series of drinks based on different flavors of "tea," before promoting them in the Liyue market.

240221208.text: Tea flavored Fonta? And you want it in different flavors...? Paimon can't imagine what those would taste like...

240221211.text: It even says here that condensed tea extract, syrup, and milk can be added to adjust the flavor.

240221212.text: That sounds interesting, but Paimon doesn't think this drink has anything to do with Fonta.

240221213.text: Exactly, and that's why this plan was scrapped — because "it has nothing to do with our main product."

240221214.text: However, I've decided to reinstate this plan — after all, developing a delicious tea-flavored drink might be interesting in its own right.

240221215.text: However, you did help me retrieve my materials, so I'd like to hear what you have to say on the matter.

240221216.text: Do you think that I should take the suggestion in this draft on board and try changing the base ingredient of Fonta to tea leaves?

240221501.text: Alright. It seems that the manner in which we're improving Fonta has got to change...

240221503.text: Ah, my dear Honorary Senior Researcher! Good to see you — most good, indeed!

240221504.text: Do you still remember me? Well, you might not, considering how busy you were previously...

240221505.text: But no matter! Allow me to introduce myself — Heinry, a member of the Fonta development team, at your service.

240221506.text: You mentioned adjusting the way in which you're improving Fonta... are you developing some all-new version of it, or something?

240221507.text: Hahaha, that's exactly what I've been doing all this time. We've had some successes and some failures, and some that even now stand at the crossroads between the two...

240221508.text: But honestly, I've been working in business-related fields too much — I fear my mind's now closer to a merchant's than that of a researcher.

240221509.text: As such, my recent development attempts have been rather uninspired, and my design plans have proved likewise...

240221510.text: *sigh* I used to have all manner of fascinating ideas back when I worked at the Research Institute...

240221511.text: But we wound up going with plans that would be easier for the public to accept, which would help Fonta sell better — many of my design drafts were left on the cutting room floor as a result.

240221512.text: But I have always believed that those original drafts contain incredible inspirational value!

240221513.text: My return to the Institute was also intended to find those drafts I left behind in my lab, and perhaps, even the samples I left behind.

240221514.text: Basically, I hope that the passionate, inspired "past-me" can give "present-me" a bit of a boost.

240221515.text: Huh? Did that lab not get caught in the explosion?

240221516.text: Hardly — it was blasted sky-high as well.

240221517.text: Wait, then where would you even begin looking for your stuff? Are you gonna use magic to get those drafts out from the ground or something?

240221518.text: Well, please let me finish. The lab was caught in the blast, yes, and that was a tragedy, but are those drafts not made of paper?

240221519.text: They might just have been blown away rather than blown to bits — as such, they'd have floated down to the earth quite safely following the initial explosion.

240221521.text: Hahaha, thank you for the praise — I've always seen it as one of my principal virtues.

240221524.text: I'm not joking here. The lab in which the Fonta research team was in was not that close to ground zero, so there's every chance that it was not directly hit by the explosion.

240221525.text: In any case, our lab had been closed for some time at that point, and there weren't any active machines in there, so there was no risk of a fire, either.

240221526.text: In the best case scenario, the documents and samples I left in there may indeed just have been knocked airborne by the shockwave rather than been utterly destroyed.

240221527.text: And with the aid of some of my colleagues, I've also been able to calculate the possible locations of said materials! The only issue is that they're... a bit far away...

240221528.text: So, my dear Honorary Senior Researcher, surely you would not leave Fonta and the Institute in the lurch, would you?
